controls.name: SQL injection
controls.evidenceAndLimits: Parameterized JDBC; hostile title/owner tests. Public database-role review remains separate.

controls.name: Cross-site scripting
controls.evidenceAndLimits: React text rendering, raw-HTML-sink check and existing hostile finding component test; proxy CSP configured, deployed CSP unverified.

controls.name: CSRF
controls.evidenceAndLimits: Origin/fetch-metadata/JSON-only mutation tests pass for local bearer/no-cookie model. Reassess with public sessions and synchronizer tokens.

controls.name: Insecure file uploads
controls.evidenceAndLimits: No upload feature; multipart disabled and upload/form requests rejected.

controls.name: IDOR and object authorization
controls.evidenceAndLimits: Repository owner isolation tested. Current HTTP API has one configured owner; public identity-to-owner mapping is not implemented.

controls.name: Rate limiting
controls.evidenceAndLimits: 240 API requests/minute global filter, preview quota and DB-backed job admission quotas. Public distributed/IP/user quotas not validated.

controls.name: Insecure JWT secrets
controls.evidenceAndLimits: No JWT issuer/parser. Shared bearer access is a separate local control; non-loopback keys require at least 32 characters.

controls.name: Exposed API secrets
controls.evidenceAndLimits: No credential patterns found by narrow source scan; no frontend auth secrets. Public secret-store/rotation review remains open.

controls.name: Weak password hashing
controls.evidenceAndLimits: No password login or password database. Use a reviewed identity provider if accounts are added.

controls.name: Missing MFA
controls.evidenceAndLimits: No account/admin identity provider yet. Require MFA for hosting/AWS/admin accounts before launch; not inferable from repository code.

controls.name: Permissive CORS
controls.evidenceAndLimits: Exact local origins; hostile/null origins rejected. No wildcard credentialed CORS. Public origin must be configured/tested separately.

controls.name: Auth tokens in local storage
controls.evidenceAndLimits: Storage holds graph/run-id/worksheet drafts only; no auth-token writes detected. Drafts must not contain sensitive data.

controls.name: Client-only permissions
controls.evidenceAndLimits: Backend validates graph bounds and repository ownership. Public request principal mapping still missing.

controls.name: Missing row-level security
controls.evidenceAndLimits: PostgreSQL RLS and least-privilege runtime roles are not implemented/verified; H2 tests do not prove them.

controls.name: Unverified webhook signatures
controls.evidenceAndLimits: No webhook endpoints or inbound provider integrations.

controls.name: SSRF
controls.evidenceAndLimits: External API nodes are numeric synthetic models, not HTTP clients. URL parameter/metadata-address payload rejected.

controls.name: Exposed source maps
controls.evidenceAndLimits: Vite source maps disabled; dist inspected for map files. Public server hidden-file/source exposure still needs a deployment scan.

controls.name: Default credentials
controls.evidenceAndLimits: Blank H2 development credentials are loopback-only. Public mode must require PostgreSQL, distinct roles and injected random credentials; not deployed.

controls.name: Sensitive logs
controls.evidenceAndLimits: Worker failure logs contain run id/type, not raw exception payload. No body/token logging configured; public log pipeline unverified.

controls.name: Vulnerable dependencies
controls.evidenceAndLimits: npm and resolved Maven runtime advisory snapshots checked. Build-plugin/container/OS scans and deployed inventory remain outstanding.

publicBlockers: No public principal/session to owner mapping
Deployment TLS, secrets, container/OS and dynamic scans pending
scope: Source hygiene and named local JUnit evidence, not penetration-test or compliance certification
